## This repository does not accept pull requests

This repo is a public tracker for [Arcane-Drafter-Godot](https://github.com/Git-Lamurette/Arcane-Drafter-Godot) — only the maintainer pushes here.

If you have a fix or improvement in mind, please **close this PR** and open an issue instead so it can be discussed:

- [Report a bug](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [Request a feature](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

Thanks for your interest in the project!
